title: Chair Defender Hesitation Cross
description: A chair stands in for the defender: the ball handler hesitates in front of it, then crosses over and attacks the rim, rehearsing the timing of a two-move attack.

content.objective: Combine a hesitation with a crossover at the right distance from a defender and finish at the rim.
content.setup: A chair at the top of the key and one at the left wing; lines at half court and the right wing.
content.organization: Players alternate starts; rebound your own ball and go to the other line.
instructions: Attack the chair at speed with the right hand.
One stride before the chair, hesitate: slow down, lift the head and shoulders as if to stop.
Cross the ball low to the left hand and step past the chair.
Drive to the rim and finish with the left hand.
From the wing line, run the same move at the second chair and finish on the other side.
coachingPoints: Hesitate close to the chair: about one arm-length away.
The crossover goes below the knee.
Accelerate past the chair's shoulder, not into it.
commonMistakes: Making the move too far from the chair.
The hesitation stops the dribble altogether.
Fading away from the rim after the move.
content.safety: Chairs are placed away from the lane so a missed finish never lands on them.
progressions: Replace the chair with a passive, then live defender.
Finish with a floater instead of a lay-up.
regressions: Walk through the move without the hesitation first.
Finish with a jump stop and a shot.
variations: Pull up for a jump shot after the move.
successCriteria: Move made within one arm-length of the chair.
content.gameApplication: The hesitation freezes the defender's feet; the crossover then attacks the side they cannot reach.
